_doc: OBJECTIVES-1 for Ultrastable itself: the same objective and metric rows bootstrap seeds for any system, so Ultrastable is measured by its own mechanism. Seeded into the self-host database by foundation/selfhost.py; read-only evidence in this file.

objectives.statement: A public site and demos that state the foundation message
A repeatable new-system generator any organization can run
Funding and outreach loops running on their own

metrics.name: ticks completed in the last hour
metrics.remedy: The clock is not turning. Check the cron, the D1 binding and tick_runs.errors.

metrics.name: dispatches in the last 24 hours
metrics.remedy: Ticks run but nothing is handed to a role.

metrics.name: items finished in the last 7 days
ultrastable.io answers
metrics.remedy: The public site is down: roll back the last deploy-site.

metrics.name: bootstrap qualify and instrument tests pass
metrics.remedy: Wire the test result into a sql or http probe.

metrics.name: outreach sends in the last 7 days
metrics.remedy: Expose the ledger count as a probe.

metrics.name: tenant store self-test passes (1 = pass)
metrics.remedy: ultrastable-tenants /health reports a failed self-test. Read its selftest result, fix tenants/src or tenants/tenantstore, and let deploy-workers redeploy it.

metrics.name: child blindspot answers the parent's health probe
metrics.remedy: The level-1 child blindspot stopped answering /health. Check the ultrastable-spinoffs Worker route and the child registry (spinoffs/registry.js); a silent child must breach here, at its parent.
